title: Efficacy and Safety Study of L608 in Patients With Systemic Sclerosis-associated Digital Ulcers
off: A Phase 2, Multicenter, Randomized, Double-Blind, Parallel-Group, Placebo-Controlled Study to Evaluate Efficacy and Safety of L608 Suspension in Patients With Systemic Sclerosis-associated Digital Ulcers
summary: This trial is designed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of L608 compared to placebo in patients with SSc-DU.
desc:
This trial is designed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of L608 compared to placebo in patients with SSc-DU, with the primary objective of exploring the effect of L608 on reducing the time to healing of the cardinal DU.

The trial utilizes a double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel group design. Approximately 40 eligible participants will be enrolled and randomized 1:1 to L608 or placebo groups at baseline.
elig:
Key Inclusion Criteria:

1. Diagnosed with systemic sclerosis per ACR/EULAR 2013 criteria.
2. Presence of at least one visible, painful digital ulcer.
3. Participants aged ≥18 years.

Key Exclusion Criteria:

1. DUs not primarily ischemic in origin.
2. Other rheumatic diseases are permitted if SSc is the predominant condition associated with DUs.
3. Active gangrene (within 3 months) or active DU infection requiring treatment (within 1 month) prior to screening

primary.m: Time to healing of the cardinal DU
